conversion_note: NOT A TWO ARM CONTRAST. This is the slope of the emission factor against N rate in the model Emis = (EF0 + dEF x N) x N, so the matching model quantity is how fast modelled N2O rises with N rate, not a ratio between two treatments. Crop specific slopes: upland grains 0.0017, rice 0.001, N fixing crops 0.018. For upland grains the fitted model is Emis = (6.49 + 0.0187 N) x N in g N2O-N per ha. UNITS CORRECTED 2026-09-17: previously recorded as "kg N2O-N per kg N per ha", which was wrong.  dEF is percentage POINTS of EF per kg N ha-1. Verified against the paper's own upland grain fit Emis = (6.49 + 0.0187 N) N with Emis in g N2O-N/ha and N in kg N/ha: EF = 6.49 + 0.0187N g N2O-N per kg N, which is 0.649 + 0.00187N in percent, so dEF/dN = 0.00187 and the paper reports 0.0017 for upland grains. USE THE CROP SPECIFIC VALUE: upland grains 0.0017, rice 0.001, N fixing 0.018. The 0.0027 all crop mean is pulled up by N fixing crops and is not the right target for a row crop panel. Table S3 gives SEM 0.00085 for this group directly, matching the 0.000842 derived from the published CI. NOTE Table S3 lists two all crop variants: 0.0027 with four outliers retained (n=233) and 0.0024 with them excluded (n=229, SEM 0.00053). Table S3 is used as printed and cannot be rebuilt from the released Dataset S1: deltaEF is populated for 233 site-years matching the table, but CropType for only 78, so the group means cannot be reconstructed from the released data.
